references.title: UU 13/2003 art.88E(1)-(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 36/2021 arts.23(1)-(3), 24(1), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025 - the UMK of the worksite, else the UMP; art.23(2): where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances the basic alone must reach it (`terms.rate.amount` plus fixed allowances). Art.24(1): the minimum binds a worker with less than one year of service; longer service follows the wage structure and scale (art.24(2)). Micro and small enterprises are outside it (art.36). Daily and hourly wages are DAILY_MINIMUM_WAGE and HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.

Minimum wages from 1 January 2026 (PP 36/2021 arts.23, 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025). `by_region` keys are “Provinsi X” (the UMP; only DKI Jakarta, which has no locality, keeps a bare key in use) or “Provinsi X/Kota|Kabupaten Y” — every kota and kabupaten of the 37 other provinces is listed, at its UMK, or at the UMP where the governor set none (no district wage council): the floor is read at the worker’s worksite (`employee_extension_data.work_region`), else at the company’s region, by exact key. A key not listed, or a bare province key of a province whose localities are listed, is refused (MINIMUM_WAGE_REGION_UNKNOWN), never floored at a lower figure. PP 36/2021 art.35D(1) as amended by PP 49/2025; the sector decrees and KBLI are stated in the second reference. Row conditions are customer inputs: exporter, assets above Rp1 trillion, Astra group, star hotel, bank category, class-A private hospital, rayon-viscose staple fibre, work in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (`entity_extension_data`), and the job category for the DKI bus and hospital rows (`employee_extension_data.umsp_job_category`); the worksite is `employee_extension_data.work_region` or the company region.

PP 36/2021 art.35D(1) as amended by PP 49/2025: the governor may set sector minimum wages (UMSP/UMSK), above the UMP/UMK, for the KBLI sectors listed; they bind workers under one year of service. `kbli` is a KBLI 2020 code or a prefix of one (a 2-digit division, a 3- or 4-digit group): a worksite whose `employee_extension_data.worksite_kbli` starts with it is covered. A province key covers every locality below it; a locality’s UMSK and its province’s UMSP both bind (the higher wins). Decrees read with their KBLI: DKI Kep. District UMSK remain separate unresolved decrees. The decree names sectors without narrower KBLI restrictions. Verified 2026-10-10 on signed Sumatera Utara governor decree 188.44/909/KPTS/2025 dated 24 December 2025, https://www.scribd.com/document/973881227/UMSK-Prop-Sumatra-Utara-2026: annexes I-IV, VI-X and XII (pages 5-8, 14-18 and 24) are transcribed by printed KBLI and exact rupiah/sen amounts. Annex X prints 1262 and 1291, normalized to the five-digit KBLI 01262 and 01291. Annex IX mixes crumb rubber and crude palm oil in the name of KBLI 10431: only the printed code is configured; rubber KBLI 22123 remains a warning. Annex V (Deli Serdang, pages 9-13) is also transcribed: all 55 printed KBLI rows and exact rupiah amounts, including lighting 27409 at 4,122,072, sawmill/metal 16102 and 24203 at 4,203,204, and all star hotels 55110 at 4,081,556 without an added star restriction. Annex XI (Medan, pages 19-23): all 71 printed rows configured with exact rupiah amounts. KBLI 2015 55111/55112/55113 convert to KBLI 2020 55110 with exact hotel class 5/4/3 respectively (floors 4465072/4465076/4464878); 64125 converts to 64121 only for private conventional foreign-exchange banks, and 64131 to 64122 only for foreign-exchange syariah banks, each 4508451. BPS official conversion table pages 335 and 340: https://ppid.bps.go.id/upload/doc/Tabel_kesesuaian_KBLI_2020_1711428500.pdf. The bank subclass is a required customer declaration, not inferred from the broader 2020 code. Missing hotel/bank scope warns.
